title: Torus computed tomography for experimental data
summary: Torus computed tomography (Torus CT) reconstructs the Fourier coefficients of an image from X-ray data along closed geodesics on the flat torus. We extend Torus CT to experimental X-ray tomographic data by converting the data to a parallel-beam geometry and mapping the measured projection angles to the geodesic directions on the torus.
